# Fix M09 parity (issue #717, task fix-m09-parity-0158)

Finding F-N1 of review #714 is fixed with one targeted Edit to `/validation_rules/M09` in `benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json`. The issue says `/rules/M09`, but the file has no `rules` key. The M09 text sits under `validation_rules`.

**Old json M09:**
"Unsupported cases or arms are recorded as answer_class unsupported and stay visible in the inventory; they are neither dropped nor scored as wrong."

**New json M09:**
"(a) An arm unavailable before dispatch is an unstarted slot (no dispatch, no delivery_interpreted, no answer_class); (b) a dispatched attempt classed answer_class unsupported is ineligible; both stay visible and are neither dropped nor scored as wrong. `unsupported -> finished_incomplete` is only the plan-end derivation."

The new text is the md M09 line (md line 46) copied word for word.

**Checks run:**
- The issue's verification logic, adapted to the `validation_rules` path, passed. M09 contains "dispatch".
- `benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md` SHA256 is still 15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933, so it is unchanged.
- I did not diff the whole json against the old file. The edit replaced only the M09 string, so no other pointer should have changed.
- New json SHA256: 82016b83e1b6126b6bd895ffc7600617a692ed73ee24c63692e676fcbc15ec85. The old one was 04543bdacb7e356bb1ea46c4256659716b0e023066cab5bf29800d769f6e193b.

Nothing else was edited. O01-O06 are untouched and no quality threshold was added. I did not run the evaluator, and no model or native run was done.

## Discoveries
- The issue's verification one-liner would fail with `KeyError: 'rules'` if run as written, because the file uses `validation_rules` (checked in the json top-level keys).
- I did not check `benchmark/preparation.json`. If it pins the json hash, it needs the new SHA256 above, and a separate task would have to do that.
